description: This file defines a static class 'ChatFormat' that provides methods for formatting and manipulating chat XML documents, including initializing the document, adding posts, finding posts, replacing text, and enforcing a maximum number of posts.

classes.name: ChatFormat
classes.description: A static class providing methods to format and manipulate chat XML documents, including initialization, post creation, search, update, and limit enforcement.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes an XML document with a root element and creation timestamp if the document is empty.

methods.name: GetPostsContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the 'posts' container element from the XML document.

methods.name: MakePost
methods.description: Creates a new 'post' XElement with specified GUID, user, timestamp, and text.

methods.name: FindPost
methods.description: Finds a post element by its GUID within the document.

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.description: Replaces the text content of a post element.

methods.name: EnforceLimit
methods.description: Ensures the number of posts does not exceed MaxNumPosts by removing the oldest post if necessary.
